title: Optimal Domain Conditions for Positivity of Hinged Plates
statement: For the hinged biharmonic plate problem $\Delta^2v=f$ with $v=0$ and $\Delta v-(1-\sigma)\kappa v_n=0$ on $\partial\Omega$, determine whether the convexity and $C^{2,1}$-boundary assumptions ensuring $f\geq0\Rightarrow v\geq0$ are optimal, or can be weakened.
